candidates.summary: The OOG-after-PayGas loop also exhausts the 10M credit window, so the fixture stays green if PayGas stops lowering the gas meter to what maxFee buys
candidates.failure_scenario: Delete `m.GasMeter.SetLimit(limit)` at gnovm/stdlibs/chain/runtime/paygas.go:61. The fixture's loop (line 47) is the same 100000-iteration `s += "x"` that paygas_credit_exhausted.txtar:36 runs past 10M gas (pinned there at `GAS USED:   100[0-9]{5}$`), so the call still dies with 'out of gas', at the 10M window instead of the 3M that PayGas(3000) buys, and the realm balance stays 10000000ugnot. On a successful tx the same mutation lets the tx run to the window while settlement caps the charge at MaxFee (gno.land/pkg/gnoland/app.go:301 `if actualCost > pgi.MaxFee`), so up to window-minus-limit gas per sponsored tx goes unpaid. TestOutOfGasLogReportsPayGasLimit calls SetLimit from its own handler rather than through X_payGas, and paygas_budget_exceeded only reaches the panic before SetLimit. Fix: pin the lowered limit, `stdout 'GAS USED:   30[0-9]{5}$'` or `stderr 'exceeds tx.s gas wanted \(3000000\)'`, or shrink the loop below 10M gas.

candidates.summary: The PayStorage-before-PayGas fixture never checks who paid msg 0's deposit, so sponsorship that silently falls back to the caller there passes
candidates.failure_scenario: The header's claim is that msg 0's deposit is charged to the realm before PayGas runs in msg 1. The only checks are that the tx succeeds and that the realm's balance is not exactly 10000000ugnot (`! stdout '10000000ugnot'`), which msg 1's gas charge alone satisfies; user1's balance is never queried. Make the keeper charge the sponsor only once a gas commitment exists (keeper.go:2454 `sponsored := sponsorRealm && entry == rlmPath && ctx.PayGasInfo() != nil && ctx.PayGasInfo().MaxFee > 0`): user1 pays msg 0's deposit, the realm pays only gas, and the fixture stays green. paygas_cross_realm_sponsors calls PayGas inside the same message, so it stays green under that mutation too. Fix: assert user1 still holds '"1000000000ugnot"' and the realm's exact balance, as paygas_cross_realm_sponsors.txtar does.

Read half: grep -n 'user1_user_addr\|bank/balances' paystorage_before_paygas.txtar.
